# How to Join

## 1) Fill out this form

[MacroMar membership application: Click here to join.](https://forms.gle/6rPBR9qcZXUctTRD7)

## 2) Sign up for the listserv

We will use the listserv to send updates about activities and funding opportunities.

-   Send an email to **`MacroMar+subscribe@googlegroups.com`**. Leave the subject line and the body of the email completely empty, then click **Send**.

-   Check your inbox for a confirmation email. Open the email and follow the instructions (usually replying to the email or clicking a link) to confirm your subscription.
